name: Shambhu Nath Pal
contribution: A local organizer associated with the Pabna peasant mobilization.
context: He appears in accounts of the movement’s organized rural resistance and rent-agitation networks.
impact: His profile helps show that agrarian politics in colonial Bengal depended on local organizers as well as formal law.
highlight: His profile helps show that agrarian politics in colonial Bengal depended on local organizers as well as formal law.
seoTitle: Shambhu Nath Pal: Organizer of the Pabna Peasant Uprising
seoDescription: Learn about Shambhu Nath Pal’s documented association with the Pabna peasant uprising and local agrarian organizing in colonial Bengal.
shortAnswer: Shambhu Nath Pal was a local organizer associated with the Pabna peasant uprising and its rural resistance networks.
